proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#9
proposed.text: Buck Cashman and Daniel Blake work together for Fisk, warning City Council members that the mayor expects their support for his Safer Streets Initiative.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fisk's young aide. Works with Buck to pressure the City Council.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's fixer. Works with Blake to pressure the City Council.

changes.evidence: Born Again S1#9 (Straight to Hell): Cashman and Blake meet the City Council together and threaten members who oppose the Safer Streets Initiative. They also work side by side on Fisk's staff through S1, so the connection starts before S2#7.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#5
proposed.text: Buck makes Blake drive out of the city with him, letting him believe he is about to be killed, then has him help bury Christofi Savva's body.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fisk's young aide, whom Buck makes help bury a body.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's fixer, who makes Blake help bury a body.

changes.evidence: Born Again S2#5: Blake believes Cashman is driving him out to kill him over BB's leaks, but they are going to bury Savva's body; Cashman uses it to bind Blake to Fisk and set him on the leaker (fandom: Blake was 'under Cashman's supervision'). The tie turns from colleagues to Buck controlling him before he kills him in S2#7.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#6
proposed.text: Buck Cashman encourages Heather Glenn to follow the example of Muse, the killer who once held her captive.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A therapist Buck sends clients, then urges to follow Muse's example.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Fisks' man. Sends Heather clients, then urges her to follow Muse.

changes.evidence: Born Again S2#6 summary: 'Cashman ... encourages Glenn to imitate Muse's actions.' She later attacks Karen (S2#7) and puts on Muse's mask (S2#8).

now.title: Iron Fist S1
now.text: Madame Gao calls her champions to the Da Jue Zhan, a duel to the death against the Iron Fist.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Their mistress, who calls them to duel the Iron Fist to the death.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Her champions, called to duel the Iron Fist to the death.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Hand leader who calls her to duel the Iron Fist to the death.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: One of her champions, called to duel the Iron Fist to the death.

changes.evidence: Both card lines are plural ('Their mistress, who calls them', 'Her champions'), so they describe the group, not the Bride. In Iron Fist S1#6 the Bride is one of Gao's four challengers at the Da Jue Zhan (the second bout), led in by Gao.

now.title: Jessica Jones S3#6
now.text: Malcolm beats up Brianna's pimp, and she comes back to his place, where the two begin an affair.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The man who beats up Brianna's pimp and begins an affair with her.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Erik's sister, who comes back to Malcolm and begins an affair with him.

changes.evidence: Jessica Jones S3#6: Malcolm beats up Gor and brings Brianna back to keep her safe from Sallinger; she then forces a single sexual encounter on him ('I won't force any more blow jobs on you', S3#10) and leaves town. That is a one-off, not a relationship. They become a couple only in S3#10, which already has its own partner stage.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#2
proposed.text: Poindexter kills two task force officers at the hospital as they try to get to the recovering Cherry, which lets Cherry's police friends take him into hiding.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The cop whose party Poindexter shot up, and whose would-be killers he later stops.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The hitman who shot up Cherry's party, then kills the officers sent after him.

changes.evidence: Born Again S2#1: Dex shoots the AVTF officers who attack Cherry and Matt at Cherry's apartment. S2#2: 'Dex kills two AVTF officers at the hospital where Cherry is recovering, allowing Cherry's police friends to take him into hiding' (fandom: Bob and Doug, 'while they were trying to get to Cherry'). Cherry's attacker now saves his life.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#6
proposed.text: Benjamin Poindexter, dressed as Daredevil, storms the New York Bulletin. He hurls a billy club at Foggy, then knocks him aside when Foggy tries to fight him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A lawyer Poindexter attacks at the Bulletin.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The fake Daredevil who attacks Foggy at the Bulletin.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#6 (The Devil You Know): at the Bulletin, Dex throws his billy club at Foggy (Matt catches it); later Foggy punches him and Dex subdues him before killing Jasper Evans. The connection starts here, not in Born Again.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#6
proposed.text: Benjamin Poindexter, dressed as Daredevil, storms the New York Bulletin, holds a gun to Karen's head, then shoots her witness Jasper Evans dead in front of her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A reporter Poindexter holds at gunpoint at the Bulletin.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The fake Daredevil who holds Karen at gunpoint and kills her witness.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#6: Dex knocks the gun from Karen's hand, lifts it to her head, then turns it on Evans and kills him, covering her in his blood. This comes before the S3#10 church attack.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#1
proposed.text: Years later Poindexter kills Foggy at Josie's Bar, then corners Karen inside and aims his gun at her until Daredevil tackles him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The woman whose friend Foggy Poindexter kills, and whom he nearly kills too.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The hitman who kills Karen's friend Foggy, then turns his gun on her.

changes.evidence: Born Again S1#1 (Heaven's Half Hour): after shooting Foggy, Bullseye throws smoke into Josie's, greets 'Hello, Karen' and points his gun at her to kill her before Daredevil tackles him.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#6
proposed.text: Karen holds the captive Poindexter at gunpoint and is about to shoot him for killing Foggy when Matt stops her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The woman who nearly shoots Poindexter for killing Foggy.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Foggy's killer, whom Karen nearly shoots.

changes.evidence: Born Again S2#6 (Requiem): Karen sits with the handcuffed Dex, aims at his forehead to avenge Foggy, and Daredevil knocks the gun away. Wikipedia: 'Page nearly kills Dex but is stopped by Murdock.'

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#2
proposed.text: FBI agent Benjamin Poindexter guards Wilson Fisk on his transfer out of prison and saves his life when the Albanians ambush the convoy.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The prisoner Poindexter guards and saves from the Albanians.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An FBI agent who saves Fisk from the Albanians.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#2: 'Fisk is saved by Special Agent Benjamin "Dex" Poindexter.' In S3#4 Fisk then covers for Dex's killing of the surrendered Albanians. They know each other well before Fisk recruits him in S3#6.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#4
proposed.text: Poindexter attacks the Fisks at Fogwell's Gym, and a glass shard from his throw strikes Vanessa in the head. Fisk is about to shoot him when Daredevil stops him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Poindexter's old boss, who nearly kills him at Fogwell's Gym.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's old weapon. Attacks the Fisks at Fogwell's Gym and wounds Vanessa.

changes.evidence: Born Again S2#4: Dex attacks Fogwell's Gym, throws an ornament at Vanessa that Fisk shatters, a shard hits Vanessa; Fisk grabs a gun to kill the wounded Dex and Daredevil disarms him. Vanessa dies of it in S2#5. S2#8 he shoots at Fisk again.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#2
proposed.text: Ray Nadeem and Benjamin Poindexter guard Wilson Fisk together, and Poindexter saves the FBI team when the Albanians ambush the convoy.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow FBI agent whose life Poindexter saves.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow agent who saves Ray's life in the convoy ambush.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#2: Nadeem and Dex escort Fisk and Dex fights off the Albanians; Nadeem later tells him he owes nothing because Dex 'saved his life', and raises a legal fund for him. The friendship the S3#8 stage describes starts here.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#13
proposed.text: Poindexter attacks the Fisks' wedding and shoots Hattley, his former superior, then tries to finish her off.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Poindexter's old FBI boss, whom he shoots at the Fisks' wedding.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Hattley suspects of lying, who later shoots her.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#13 (A New Napkin): during the attack on the wedding Dex shoots Hattley in the abdomen, pulls the trigger again on an empty gun, and throws it into her face.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#12
proposed.text: Benjamin Poindexter introduces himself to Vanessa as Fisk's new Wesley. She persuades Fisk to have Ray Nadeem killed, and they send Poindexter to do it.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fisk's fiancée, who has Poindexter sent to kill Ray Nadeem.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's new right hand, sent to kill Nadeem at her urging.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#12: Dex brings the painting to the penthouse and calls himself the new James Wesley to Vanessa; 'Vanessa convinces him otherwise. They send Dex, who kills Nadeem.' S3#13: Manning confirms Vanessa ordered Nadeem's death.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#13
proposed.text: Poindexter crashes the Fisks' wedding and tries again and again to kill Vanessa, until Daredevil and Fisk stop him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fisk's bride, whom Poindexter tries to kill at their wedding.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's old weapon, who tries to kill Vanessa at her wedding.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#13: Dex 'attacks Fisk and Vanessa' at the wedding; he throws the microphone, then a paperweight at Vanessa, and Daredevil deflects both before Fisk breaks his back.

now.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#8
now.text: Vanessa Fisk hired Benjamin Poindexter to kill Foggy Nelson. Poindexter turns on the Fisks and attacks their ball at Gracie Mansion.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The woman who hired Poindexter to kill Foggy.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The hitman Vanessa hired, who turns on her.

changes.evidence: Born Again S1#8 leaves them as enemies: Matt deduces Vanessa hired Dex (an earlier, off-screen deal), and Dex escapes Rikers and shoots at the Fisks' ball, aiming first at Vanessa, then at Fisk. With the S3 stages added, the hire is backstory, and the through-line from this title is enmity.

now.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#9
now.text: Vanessa had Poindexter released so he would kill Foggy and keep the Red Hook port secret.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The woman who frees Poindexter and hires him to kill Foggy.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The hitman Vanessa frees and hires, who turns on her.

changes.evidence: Born Again S1#9 only shows in flashback how Vanessa freed and hired Dex. In the present he has just tried to kill the Fisks and is on the run from the AVTF. He hunts them through S2.

Luke Cage S2#9: Ridley takes command of the precinct, agrees to Mariah's immunity deal and arrives at Harlem's Paradise with a warrant for Bushmaster, but he is already gone. Neither her page nor the summaries show the two meeting or anything passing between them; she only knows of him as a suspect.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S2#2
proposed.text: Bushmaster comes to Tilda Johnson's shop for the herbs he needs to strengthen his nightshade, and she sells them to him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A herbalist who sells Bushmaster his nightshade herbs.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A customer who buys herbs from Tilda to strengthen his nightshade.

changes.evidence: Luke Cage S2#2 (Straighten It Out): 'Bushmaster visits holistic doctor Tilda Johnson to get ingredients for augmenting the plant nightshade.' They meet long before S2#9.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S2#7
proposed.text: Bushmaster ties up Tilda with her mother Mariah and sets their house on fire, cutting Tilda loose and leaving her to save Mariah if she can.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Mariah's daughter, whom Bushmaster leaves in a burning house.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Leaves Tilda and her mother in a burning house.

changes.evidence: Luke Cage S2#7: Bushmaster catches Mariah and Tilda and 'leaves them in a burning house'; fandom: he recognizes Tilda from her shop, cuts her ties and gives her the choice to save her mother before lighting the fire.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#12
proposed.text: Hunter still distrusts Creel, now Talbot's bodyguard, on a joint mission. Creel knocks him out to keep his search for Talbot's son secret, then helps him fight off Hydra agents.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hartley's teammate, who still hunts Creel, and whom Creel later helps fight Hydra.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hartley's killer. Later knocks Hunter out, then fights Hydra beside him.

changes.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#12 (The Inside Man): Hunter tails Creel, finds Talbot's son in stasis and is knocked out by Creel; later Hunter and Morse kill Hydra agents 'with the help of Creel' (Creel saves him from an ambush), though Hunter says they are not even.
